entityDescription:
I-ENERGYLINK is an Innovation and Development focused Organization, active in the energy sector development at European and international level. MISSION:I-ENERGYLINK’s is accelerating clean energy by supporting innovative solutions that most effectively increase energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, consolidate the regulatory framework and improve overall power systems reliability. EXPERIENCE: I-ENERGYLINK is built on the experience of over 30 years in the electricity industry in electricity T&D&G Projects and Studies, as well as Regulation, Policy and Innovation Solutions. Cybersecurity solutions and Digitalisation of the power sector are part of our experience and priorities. We deliver high-quality research and innovation solutions, as well as original analysis to energy stakeholders and policymakers to help them make informed choices on energy related projects, solutions, and policy. Electricity Transmission: Professional working experience with European Network of Transmission System Operators-ENTSO-E and Mediterranean TSOs –Med-TSO, on System Operations, Project’s implementation in Electricity Transmission Grid, SCADA systems, Protections and Automations. Working close to the Agency for the Cooperation of Energy Regulators (ACER) and the National Regulatory Authorities, in the field of the Internal Electricity Market. Managing several Network and System Development Projects for the preparation of the Ten-Year Networks Development Plan – TYNDP, HV electricity infrastructure, Smart Grids, Network Codes, Electricity Highways. Coordination of Regional Investment Plans and PCIs selection as well as monitoring 4/6 ENTSO-E regions: North Seas, Baltic Seas, Continental South-West Europe, Continental Central-East European HV grid development and integration of Renewable Energy Sources (RES). Project management and implementation of the EU financed Action “Mediterranean Project I” for Med-TSO. Strong impact on Electricity Interconnections and on harmonisation the regulatory framework in the Mediterranean Region. Electricity Distribution: Coordination and Implementation of Policy and Regulation activities together with and for European Distribution System Operators – DSOs on electricity Distribution Networks, Smart Grids, TSOs and DSOs Cooperation, Regulation and Policy, RES and DG, Research, Development and Innovation. Active in the EC BRIDGE Initiative on electricity distribution and regulations, coordinating the Group of Smart Grids and Energy Storage. Relevant experience in managing international energy projects financed by IFIs, including Economic Resilience Initiative – Infrastructure Tech. Assistance – ERI – ITA financed by the European Investment Bank (EIB) – the West Bank Power Distribution Reinforcement Study Palestine (West Bank) on the Five Years Electricity Distribution Network Reinforcement Investment Plan (5YDNRIP). Experience with DSOs on leading strategic, financial and technical analysis, defining and implementing DSO strategy. Working with major European DSOs. Focusing on investments & Smart Grids, RES & DG integration to the Electricity Distribution Grid.
Electricity Generation: Managing several Small Hydro Power Plant– SHPP generation Projects (<10 MW) from design, implementation, operation and optimization. All project cycle management: studies, design, tenders, defining and supervision of the execution of the Work Plan for Project investments. Implementing Wind and PV Plant generation and operation with innovative cyber-security solutions.

description:
CLOUDWATER Ltd is a Research & Development startup SME company focusing on low-cost GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite System) receiver development established in 2021 at Nicosia, the capital city of Cyprus. CLOUDWATER also conducts high-level research on GNSS receiver’s software and hardware development, as well as on GNSS Meteorology, Geodesy and Positioning, Atmospheric Remote Sensing and Weather Prediction. The company designs and develops an innovative, customized low-cost GNSS receiver unit, particularly for the estimation of Precipitable Water Vapour (PWV) in Earth’s atmosphere. Our PREcipitable WAter vapour Monitor, PREWAM, is a unique product based on the novel concept of low-cost near-real time monitoring of PWV over an area, by exploiting all available GNSS systems (GPS, GALILEO, GLONASS and BeiDou). 
Website: https://cloudwater.com.cy

description:
DYCSYT (DYnamics and Control of SYstems – Tools) is a spin-off of ISAE-Supaero, which develops and distributes the SDTlib (Satellite Dynamics Toolbox – Library), a software dedicated to the modeling of flexible space systems and aimed at improving their GNC/AOCS design, with a unique expertise in:
* flexible dynamics,
* parametric uncertainties,
* mechanisms and vibrations.
 The SDTlib was initially developed in an academic context through published studies, in partnership with ESA, CNES, ONERA, and industrial partners, for applications such as vibrations isolation, control/structure co-design, in-orbit servicing, high-accuracy pointing missions, characterization of vibration anomaly observed in flight…
 Through a subscription service, our objective is to maintain a state-of-the-art, fully documented modeling tool in line with the industrial needs, along with services based on our expertise in this field.
entityDescription:
DyCSyT (DYnamics and Control of SYstems - Tools) conducts research and development in the modeling and control of microvibrations in space systems. It aims to provide numerical tools to satellite constructors to improve their GNC design, particularly for missions with stringent performance requirements, by bridging the gap between mature academic research and industrial applications.

The main activity of DyCSyT is the development of the SDTlib (Satellite Dynamics Toolbox - Library), the result of 15 years of academic research at ISAE-Supaero. The SDTlib allows the control engineer to easily assemble the model of complex space systems in a multi-body framework ; it has the unique advantage of providing a fully parameterized model, based on the LFT (Linear Fractional Transformation) formalism, to take into account uncertain or time-varying parameters and enable advanced tools to perform robust analysis and control.

The SDTlib, along with these advanced model- and optimization-based tools:
- reduces the tedious iterations in the design process - by providing a precise performance prediction early in the design process, taking into account the robustness as well as all performance constraints as of the controller synthesis, or again optimizing the structure simultaneously with the controller ;
- improves the performance - e.g. in terms of pointing precision, actuator's solicitation, or minimization of the satellite's mass.

In an academic context, the SDTlib has allowed to tackle various problematics such as: disturbance rejection for fine line-of-sight pointing control, modeling of harmonic microvibrations caused by reaction wheels or solar array driving mechanism, control/structure co-design of large flexible structures, or on-orbit servicing. DyCSyT is committed to making this technology available for practical engineering applications and to continuing its development to meet the industry's needs.

entityName: IRCCS - Fondazione del Piemonte per l'Oncologia
entityDescription:
The Istituto di Candiolo IRCCS is a specialist centre for the treatment of oncological conditions, for a number of which, indeed, it figures as an international benchmark, and is part of theOncological Network of Piedmont-Aosta Valley.
It is the first Research Institute of Admission and Care in Piedmont to be recognized by the Ministry of Health.
For the number of cases treated and the quality of its clinical profiles, the Institute is recognized for its excellent standards in the following areas:
- diagnosis and therapy of cancers of the breast and of the ovaries;
- ​diagnosis and therapy of gastrointestinal and hepatobiliary tumours;
- diagnosis and therapy of onco-haematological diseases;
- diagnosis and therapy of sarcomas and rare tumours;
- diagnosis and therapy of skin cancers;
- diagnosis and therapy of cervicocephalic (ORL) tumours.
The Institute's specialists have at their disposal new Operating Theatres, isolation rooms with controlled microclimate for immuno-suppressed patients, innovative pharmocological protocols (also in the area of innovative “targeted therapy”), of sophisticated apparatus in the field of medical imaging (Computerized Axial Tomography, Positron Emission Tomography, Nuclear Magnetic Resonance, Scintigraphy) and of radiotherapy (the Institute is one of the few European facilities which can boast two Tomotherapy systems).
At the Istituto di Candiolo it is possible to benefit from out-patient care (specialist consultations, diagnostic tests, instrumental surgery):

Multidisciplinary Programmes
At the Candiolo Institute there are a number of specialized multidisciplinary programmes for the diagnosis and treatment of oncological diseases.
The multidisciplinary teams of the Institute make use of specialists with consolidated experience and expertise in: pathological anatomy, pancreatic and colo-rectal hepatobiliary surgery, maxillofacial surgery, oncological surgery, plastic-reconstructive surgery, dermatosurgery, endocrinology, oncological gynecology, nuclear medicine, nutrition , odontostomatology, medical oncology, orthopedics, otolaryngology, psychology, radiodiagnostics, surgical radiology, radiation therapy
Integration of the various competencies makes it possible to tackle the complex problems of oncological diseases, from diagnosis to the planning of therapies to follow-up strategies, to achieving the best clinical results combined with the safeguard of quality of life standards.
It is possible to access the following diagnosis and treatment programmes:
- Pancreatic and Colorectal Hepatobiliary Surgery Programme
- Diagnostic and Surgical Digestive Endoscopy Programme
- Ovarian Carcinoma Programme
- Sarcomas and Rare Tumours Programme
- Stem Cell Transplantation Programme

entityDescription: upLYFT is creating the next-generation of smart vibrational wearables to holistically support one's musculoskeletal system by increasing muscle recruitment, safeguarding against injury, facilitating muscle recovery and increasing bone density. We are embedding custom designed transducers within textiles to mechanically stimulate the proprioceptive system. We are promoting maintained physical activity as you age to encourage muscle and bone remodelling by offering an alternative way of stimulating your body for those who cannot use conventional techniques due to the extent of their physical condition. Our device therefore mitigates the risk of the elderly becoming inactive as they age but also helps manage existing MSK issues. Processing the physiological data collected by embedded sensors, our machine learning algorithms adapt the stimulation to ensure that the user's musculoskeletal system is best supported at all times. Furthermore, we offer real time movement tracking to inform both the user and clinician on how their mobility is improving.

Company description: The Łukasiewicz - Institute of Microelectronics and Photonics (Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz – Instytut Mikroelektroniki I Fotoniki) was founded on 1 October 2020 on the merger of the Łukasiewicz - Institute of Electron Technology and the Łukasiewicz- Institute of Electronic Materials Technology. The institute belongs to Łukasiewicz Research Network (Sieć Badawcza Łukasiewicz).
The Instituteconducts scientific research and performs developmental work in the fields of micro- and nano-electronics, materials engineering , optoelectronics and nano-photonics, microwave electronics, power electronics, transparent and flexible electronics. The Institute implements and disseminates the results of these works in the economy, being open to cooperation with entrepreneurs.
The scope of the Institute’s operations includes in particular:
• development of the design and production technology of micro- and opto-electronic solid-state devices, including: microwave and photonic discrete elements, detectors and sensors, integrated circuits microsystems and electronic subassemblies, and microelectronic hybrid systems power devices, diffraction elements ;
• development of methods for the design of micro- and optoelectronic solid state devices, and development of new methods for characterization materials, structures and solid state devices;
• development of technologies for the production of new materials, such as, silicon carbide, epitaxial graphene, flake graphene, ceramic-metal composites, advanced ceramics, as well as testing their properties for industrial use;
• standardization, certification, and approval activities.
The research at the Institute is organized around technology lines for: optoelectronic subassemblies, silicon subassemblies, wide band gap semiconductor subassemblies, advanced materials and the LTCC technology. These state of the arts lines enable the scientific community to participate in research, and entrepreneurs to develop new solutions.

entityDescription:
AgileMMICInc. is a start-up company that is the result of research activities developed at the University of Calgary over the past 25 years. It was incorporated in 2018 by leading research teams in the area of RF front-end and RF power amplifier design and modelling.

AgileMMIC aims to transform the way RF frontends are designed for the next generations of wireless and space communication systems. Introduction of new circuit architectures and design techniques would make the integration of RF frontends using high-end semiconductor technologies affordable to replace conventional distributed designs.
AgileMMIC provides design and technology of monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMIC) and is a pioneer that have successfully developed Gallium Nitride RF frontend circuitry. Proprietary power amplification technology provides support for mmWave, MMIC, and Massive MIMO deployments

AgileMMIChas developed a unique set of intellectual property and trade secrets to design discrete and monolithic microwave integrated circuits (MMIC) in frequencies from S-to K-bands

- Power amplifiers (High efficiency, broad bandwidth, load modulated)

- LNAs (in GaN, robust against overdrive (no need for limiters))

- Switches (high power, low-loss, integrated)RF front-ends (fully integrated in GaN technology)
